summary.plain: Two hilltop stations of telescopes that photograph the faint ultraviolet light of cosmic-ray air showers over the Utah desert.
summary.technical: HiRes-I (22 telescope modules, 3-17 degrees elevation) and HiRes-II (42 modules, 3-31 degrees), each module a 3.7 m2 spherical mirror with a 256-PMT camera of 1 degree pixels; 12.6 km apart for stereo.

technology.quote: A cluster of 256 photomultiplier tubes (PMTs) is placed at the focal plane of each mirror and serves as the camera for each telescope.
technology.value: Two stations of spherical-mirror telescopes with 256-PMT cameras that image nitrogen fluorescence from air showers.
